name: Taj Dal View
tagline: Perched on Kralsangri hill offering panoramic vistas of Dal Lake and Zabarwan ranges.
shortDescription: Overlooking the placid waters of Dal Lake and framed by the majestic Zabarwan mountain range, Taj Dal View is the epitome of luxury hospitality in Srinagar with heated pool, fine dining, and Jiva spa.

name: The LaLiT Grand Palace
tagline: The former royal residence of Maharaja Pratap Singh surrounded by century-old Chinar trees.
shortDescription: Built in 1910 by Maharaja Pratap Singh, The LaLiT Grand Palace Srinagar is a royal heritage masterpiece overlooking Dal Lake with palatial suites, heated indoor pool, and regal dining.

name: Sarovar Premiere
tagline: Sophisticated contemporary comfort, world-class dining and premium executive hospitality.
shortDescription: Conveniently positioned in the central business district of Srinagar at Regal Chowk on M.A. Road, Sarovar Premiere offers refined five-star luxury with elegantly appointed rooms, wellness spa, and round-the-clock service.

name: WelcomHeritage
tagline: Curated heritage hospitality celebrating royal Kashmiri artistry, traditions and calm waters.
shortDescription: Positioned conveniently along Airport Road in Srinagar, WelcomHeritage represents the pinnacle of Kashmiri cultural grandeur with hand-carved deodar woodwork, royal butler service, and exquisite Wazwan.

name: Asian Park
tagline: Modern deluxe stay minutes from Dal Lake, Boulevard promenade and Mughal gardens.
shortDescription: Located on M.A. Link Road in Munawarabad, Asian Park Hotel blends modern elegance with traditional Kashmiri warmth, centrally heated rooms, and easy connectivity to Dal Lake.

name: Namrose Resorts & Spa
tagline: A stylish sanctuary with restorative spa therapy and fine multi-cuisine dining.
shortDescription: Set in Munawarabad, Srinagar, Namrose Resorts & Spa features chic designer interiors, scenic balcony rooms, full-body restorative therapies, and warm Kashmiri hospitality.

name: Comrade Inn
tagline: Refined hospitality in the fashionable shopping and residential quarter of Rajbagh.
shortDescription: Comrade Inn is an esteemed 4-star boutique hotel located in Rajbagh, Srinagar's diplomatic heart. Offering premium sound-insulated guestrooms with individual climate controls and fine dining.

name: OV Boutique
tagline: Contemporary minimalist aesthetics combined with thoughtful, intimate guest service.
shortDescription: OV Boutique Hotel delivers a refreshingly contemporary experience in upscale Rajbagh, Srinagar with clean minimalist lines, cozy electric heating blankets, in-house coffee bar, and attentive staff.

name: Midtown Greens
tagline: Peaceful green gardens and comfortable family accommodations in Baghat, Srinagar.
shortDescription: Tucked away in the peaceful residential enclave of Baghat, Srinagar, Midtown Greens offers a serene garden sanctuary with spacious bedrooms, home-style meals, and helpful travel staff.

name: Pride Inn
tagline: Dependable comfort, spotless amenities and warm Kashmiri hospitality in Rajbagh.
shortDescription: Pride Inn is a trusted 3-star property in Rajbagh, Srinagar recognized for its spotless hygiene, generous room dimensions, and polite staff, making it perfect for families seeking great value.

name: The Khyber Himalayan Resorts & Spa
tagline: World-renowned Himalayan ski resort nestled 8,825 feet high with Apharwat panoramas.
shortDescription: Perched at 8,825 feet on Hotel Khyber Road in Gulmarg, The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa is India's most celebrated alpine luxury resort with ski-in access, heated indoor glass pool, and L'Occitane Spa.

name: Hilltop
tagline: Walking distance from the Gulmarg Gondola with cozy alpine wood fireplaces.
shortDescription: Hotel Hilltop Gulmarg is ideally situated in Gulmarg within walking distance of the Gondola base station. Featuring warm pine-paneled rooms, central heating, a roaring lobby fireplace, and snow mountain views.

name: Apple Tree Resorts
tagline: Surrounded by fragrant apple orchards and snow-clad foothills on Tangmarg Road.
shortDescription: Located along Tangmarg Road in Kunzer at the gateway to Gulmarg, Apple Tree Resorts offers cozy heated cottages surrounded by apple orchards, bonfire evenings, and hearty meals.

name: Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Pine N Peak
tagline: Pahalgam's premier five-star sanctuary perched high on Aru Road overlooking the valley.
shortDescription: Perched on scenic Aru Road in Pahalgam overlooking the Lidder River and snow-crested pine ridges, Welcomhotel Pine N Peak is Pahalgam's premier branded 5-star resort blending timber architecture with luxury.

name: Mountnoor Sarovar Premiere
tagline: Lavish river-valley luxury framed by the rushing Lidder at Sallar Dalseer, Pahalgam.
shortDescription: Setting a new benchmark for five-star indulgence at Sallar Dalseer in Pahalgam, Mountnoor Sarovar Premiere features magnificent alpine architecture, temperature-controlled luxury suites, and Lidder river views.

name: The Walnut Creek
tagline: Elegant riverside getaway enveloped by ancient walnut trees in Dewathoo, Pahalgam.
shortDescription: The Walnut Creek is an enchanting 4-star boutique retreat located in Dewathoo, Pahalgam. Offering cedar-clad rooms, private sitting verandas, Lidder river views, and evening lawn bonfires.

name: Black Pearl Houseboat
tagline: Authentic traditional cedar houseboat stay on the serene waters of Dal Lake.
shortDescription: Moored on the tranquil waters of Dal Lake in Srinagar, Black Pearl Houseboat offers authentic Kashmiri heritage comfort with traditional cedar woodcraft, warm hospitality, heated rooms, and sunset Shikara views.

name: Houseboat Royal Star
area: Gate No. 14, Dal Lake, Gagribal, Srinagar
tagline: Hand-carved cedar floating palace offering traditional Shikara crossings and lake living.
shortDescription: Moored near Gate No. 14 at Gagribal on Dal Lake, Srinagar, Houseboat Royal Star provides an authentic Kashmiri heritage stay with walnut-wood carvings, chandeliers, sun-deck, and private Shikara ferry service.

name: Mascot Houseboats
tagline: The jewel of tranquil Nigeen Lake celebrated for royal luxury and unmatched privacy.
shortDescription: Widely acclaimed as one of Kashmir's most prestigious luxury houseboat fleets, Mascot Houseboats is anchored on serene Nigeen Lake in Srinagar with palatial rooms, dedicated butler hospitality, and Wazwan dining.
